subject: Next steps — pick a 30-min preview window & stakeholder list
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@aperturehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Following up from today — propose two short windows for a product preview

Hi Marta —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap on the discovery: Aperture is looking to standardize inference across several internal teams, reduce per-token cost for generation-heavy workflows, and get clearer telemetry for latency and spend per route. We covered high-level architecture and the two main constraints you flagged (data residency and SOC 2 evidence).

Next step: a focused 30-minute product preview for your core stakeholders (product owner, platform lead, and one infra/ops engineer). To keep this small and actionable, can you confirm which of the two windows below works best for you? If neither, pick one of the fallback times.

Option A: Thu Dec 10 — 10:00–10:30 PT
Option B: Thu Dec 10 — 15:00–15:30 PT
Fallback: Fri Dec 11 — 09:00–09:30 PT

Suggested agenda (30m):
- 5m: quick objectives + success criteria
- 15m: short walkthrough (hosted API, Dedicated routing, private deployment options)
- 10m: Q&A + next steps (security info, procurement path)

If you can, include the stakeholders you want in the room and any must-cover topics (e.g., SOC 2 scope, KMS/HSM integration, on-prem packaging). I’ll loop in our SE for technical follow-ups once we lock a time.

Thanks — I’ll hold the windows until EOD PT.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
[Attachment: redwood-demo-one-pager.pdf (pdf)]

From: Marta Ruiz <marta@aperturehealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Blake <tom.blake@aperturehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 16:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Following up from today — propose two short windows for a product preview

Thanks Logan —

Appreciate the recap. Tom (cc) will be our platform lead; I’ll add Jana (security) to the invite once we pick a time (she’s OOO tomorrow morning). Of the options, Option B (Thu Dec 10 — 15:00 PT) looks best for Tom and me. If Jana can’t make the time, she’ll send a list of SOC 2 questions in advance.

Must-cover items for us:
- How you handle customer-managed KMS/HSM in Private deployments
- Audit logs retention and access controls (we need 3 years)
- Typical latency SLOs for text-generation pipelines (95th percentile)

We prefer a short, demo-first format with 10–15 minutes for technical questions. Can you invite your SE and include any prep doc we should skim?

Thanks,
Marta
Head of Integrations | Aperture Health
marta@aperturehealth.com | +1 (617) 555-8899

Thanks — looking forward to Thursday. Short agenda and who should attend: 

Agenda (30m)
- 0–5m: Introductions + confirm success criteria (Logan + Aperture)
- 5–20m: Live preview (Neha) — hosted API, routing to Dedicated, private deployment outline, demo of console traces + token-level cost breakdown

Optional attendees: Jana (security), one infra/ops engineer who owns KMS or logging.
